verdict.rationale: The only programmatic output path in the evidence is publishing: the Server API is documented to 'automate publishing', which produces the live site as a production format. External agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) also get direct access to the canvas and components. Nothing shows an agent rendering screenshots or images, or exporting design assets or code, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented screenshot/image rendering endpoint, asset or code export formats, an API reference or spec for export operations, hands-on corroboration.
